headline: Discussion of a grant to place Central High School on the National Register and the South Manchester Rail Trail Extension.
summary: The meeting covers a Certified Local Government grant to list Central High School on the National Register of Historic Places. It also covers a reply to CMA Engineers on possible impacts to historic resources from the South Manchester Rail Trail Extension.
items: Certified Local Government grant to place Central High School on the National Register of Historic Places

Additional discussion items at the Commission's discretion

plain_text:
City of Manchester Heritage Commission 
Meeting Agenda and 
Public Hearing Notice 
 
Meeting Date:  Tuesday, October 27, 2026 
Meeting Time:  5:30 P.M. 
Meeting Location: Walter Stiles Conference Room- City Hall  
 
 
Agenda  
1. Chair calls the meeting to order and Roll Call:  
 
 
2. Certified Local Government:  
 
The Commission will discuss the Certified Local Government grant to place the Central High 
School on the National Register of Historic Places.  
 Review grant process 
 Timeline and steps forward 
 
3. South Manchester Rail Trail 
 
CMA Engineers representing the City of Manchester and NHDOT, are requesting a response 
for Resource Agency Coordination for the South Manchester Rail Trail Extension project. The 
Commission should discuss any potential impacts to historic resources in the project scope, and 
submit a reply.  
 
Additional Business: 
 
1. Election of vacant Commission Officers and updated nominations 
2. Discussion of the Preservation Alliance: 2026 Seven to Save 
3. Additional discussion items at the Commissions discretion.  
 
Adjournment:  Without objection, the Chair gavels the meeting to a close.
